hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path") or d.get("tool_response",{}).get("filePath") or "")'); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.php) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; rel="${f#"$PWD"/}"; docker compose exec -T -w /var/www/html app true 2>/dev/null || exit 0; docker compose exec -T -w /var/www/html app ./vendor/bin/pint "$rel" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; case "$rel" in app/*) out=$(docker compose exec -T -w /var/www/html app ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse "$rel" --no-progress --no-ansi 2>&1) || { echo "$out"; exit 2; };; esac
